title: Generative AI Engineer - Specialist
subtitle: LLM fundamentals, RAG pipelines, fine-tuning with PEFT/LoRA, multimodal generation, and production GenAI application development.

phases.title: LLM Foundations & Prompt Engineering
phases.description: Transformer model internals, tokenization, embeddings, LLM architecture overview, and prompt engineering techniques.

nodes.title: LLM Architecture, Tokenization & Embeddings
nodes.description: Transformer architecture for generative models, BPE tokenization, semantic embedding spaces, and LLM inference.
topics: Transformer architecture for generative models (decoder-only)
Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) and SentencePiece tokenization
Token embeddings and positional encoding
Key-Value caching for efficient autoregressive generation
LLM inference: temperature, top-k, top-p (nucleus) sampling
Prompt engineering: zero-shot, few-shot, chain-of-thought prompting

resources.title: Andrej Karpathy — Build GPT from Scratch (YouTube)

checklist: Tokenize a text corpus with Hugging Face tokenizers and analyze vocab statistics.
Generate text using GPT-2 with custom temperature and top-p sampling.
Implement chain-of-thought prompting on a math reasoning task.

nodes.title: LLM Fine-Tuning with PEFT & LoRA Adapters
nodes.description: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT), PEFT adapter techniques, LoRA low-rank decomposition, and quantization for edge deployment.
topics: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on domain-specific instruction datasets
Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (PEFT): adapters vs full fine-tuning
LoRA (Low-Rank Adaptation): rank decomposition and alpha scaling
QLoRA: 4-bit quantized LoRA for GPU-limited training
Quantization methods: GPTQ, AWQ, and bitsandbytes NF4
Model evaluation metrics: ROUGE, BLEU, perplexity
checklist: Fine-tune a 7B LLM on a custom Q&A dataset using LoRA.
Apply 4-bit QLoRA training within 16GB GPU memory budget.
Evaluate fine-tuned model with ROUGE score vs base model.

phases.title: RAG Pipelines & LLM Application Development
phases.description: Vector databases, document chunking, RAG retrieval pipelines, LangChain agents, and LlamaIndex knowledge bases.

nodes.title: RAG: Vector Databases & Retrieval Pipelines
nodes.description: Building Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems with vector embeddings, semantic search, and knowledge bases.
topics: Vector databases: Pinecone, Chroma, Weaviate, FAISS
Text embedding models: sentence-transformers, OpenAI text-embedding-3
Document chunking strategies: fixed-size, semantic, recursive
Hybrid search: dense retrieval + BM25 keyword re-ranking
RAG pipeline: document indexing, query embedding, context injection
Context window optimization and retrieval quality evaluation

resources.title: DeepLearning.AI — LangChain for LLM App Dev (Free Short Course)

checklist: Index a PDF document corpus into a Chroma vector database.
Build an end-to-end RAG pipeline answering questions over a codebase.
Evaluate retrieval recall at k=5 using a labeled question set.

nodes.title: LangChain & LlamaIndex Agent Development
nodes.description: Building autonomous LLM agents with tool use, chain-of-thought reasoning, memory, and LangChain expression language.
topics: LangChain core: LCEL chains, prompts, and output parsers
ReAct agents: Reasoning and Acting with tool calls
Custom tool definitions and API integration
Memory types: ConversationBufferMemory, vector-store memory
LlamaIndex knowledge base construction and query engines
Error handling and output validation in LLM pipelines
checklist: Build a ReAct agent with web search + calculator tools.
Add conversation memory to a multi-turn chatbot.
Create a LlamaIndex query engine over a structured database.

phases.title: Multimodal AI & Production GenAI Infrastructure
phases.description: Stable Diffusion image generation, text-to-image pipelines, CI/CD for LLM apps, and production monitoring.

nodes.title: Multimodal AI: Image Generation & Vision-Language
nodes.description: Stable Diffusion architecture, ControlNet, CLIP vision-language models, and text-to-image/image-to-text systems.
topics: Diffusion model fundamentals: forward noising and denoising score matching
Stable Diffusion architecture: U-Net, VAE, CLIP text encoder
ControlNet for pose, edge, and depth-conditioned image generation
CLIP: Contrastive Language-Image Pretraining and zero-shot classification
LLaVA / Idefics multimodal vision-language models
Text-to-image API integration (Stability AI, DALL-E, Midjourney API)

resources.title: DeepLearning.AI — How Diffusion Models Work (Free Short Course)

checklist: Generate images using a Stable Diffusion pipeline with custom prompts.
Apply ControlNet with a Canny edge map for precise composition.
Build a CLIP-based zero-shot image classifier on 10 classes.

nodes.title: GenAI Infrastructure: CI/CD, Testing & Production Monitoring
nodes.description: Testing LLM apps, CI/CD pipelines, A/B testing, cost optimization, model drift detection, and production logging.
topics: Testing GenAI applications: unit tests, integration tests, evals
CI/CD for LLM applications with GitHub Actions
LLM evaluation frameworks: RAGAS, TruLens, DeepEval
Cost optimization: caching, batching, and model routing
Model drift detection and automated retraining triggers
Production logging and observability with LangSmith
checklist: Write an automated eval suite for a RAG pipeline using RAGAS.
Set up a GitHub Actions CI workflow running LLM integration tests.
Implement semantic caching to reduce LLM API costs by 40%+.
